evals.prompt: I just finished a feature branch with 3 new pages and 2 API changes. QA this worktree for me — I want to see everything tested and then play with it myself.
evals.expected_output: Should run all 4 phases: diff inventory listing 5 changes, launch stack via worktree-self-host, test all 5 features via playwright-cli, generate report, and open Chrome for manual testing.

evals.prompt: smoke test the worktree — just make sure nothing's broken and let me try it
evals.expected_output: Should run a lighter version: diff summary, host the stack, smoke-test core flows (not exhaustive), open Chrome. Should still produce a report but with fewer test cases.

evals.prompt: I've got a worktree with only backend API changes (no frontend). Run the full QA loop on it.
evals.expected_output: Should detect no frontend, use curl-based testing instead of playwright-cli for API endpoints, still generate a report, and note that browser handoff is skipped or points to API docs.
